name: Medina of Tunis
description: The Medina is the old walled heart of Tunis, Tunisia's capital, a maze of narrow lanes, covered souks and whitewashed alleys with blue doors. Between the 12th and 16th centuries, under the Almohads and Hafsids, Tunis ranked among the wealthiest cities in the Islamic world. Today about 700 monuments remain, including palaces, mosques, mausoleums, madrasas and fountains, packed into a single walkable quarter.
